result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **Bitwarden Teams** for the best balance of security, functionality, and price. However, **1Password** is arguably the better choice if ease of use and employee adoption are your top priorities.

Here are the three I'd seriously consider.

## Best password managers for small teams

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

(Best overall value)

# \$4

- Shared password collections
- Admin console and audit logs
- Directory sync and SCIM
- Open-source core
  
  [Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

- Strong administrative controls
- Excellent browser and mobile apps
  
  [1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business/)

Per user/month, billed annually, Business Starter

- Centralized administration
- Secure password sharing
- Business-focused security features
- More advanced controls on higher tiers
  
  [Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

Pricing based on published November 2026 comparisons; verify current checkout pricing and plan limits. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My comparison

| Feature | Bitwarden | 1Password | Keeper |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Affordability | Excellent | Good | Excellent |
| Ease of use | Very good | Excellent | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Audit capabilities | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Best for | Value | Usability | Budget |


## What I'd prioritize for a small team

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share company credentials without sending passwords through Slack or email.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login.
3. **Role-based permissions\:** Not everyone should have access to everything.
4. **Employee offboarding\:** Quickly revoke access when someone leaves.
5. **Two-factor authentication\:** Protect the password manager itself.
6. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to Bitwarden and 1Password.

- Choose Bitwarden if you want excellent security features without spending much.
- Choose 1Password if you want a polished experience that employees will find easy to adopt.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

I can make a more definitive recommendation with two details\:

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
